analysis:
The PR change to docs/reference/configuration.md is documentation only. Per file_changes, head lines 400-401 add two env-var rows: DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CHAINED and DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CARRY. The supplied head_text unit covers lines 1-353, so the new rows at 400-401 were not visible. The base unit (lines 519+) and the head unit I could read contain no security-relevant changes. I could only evaluate the patch excerpt for the added rows.

The rows describe default-on, process-local Qwen MTP decode/carry scheduling toggles. They are read in libs/mlx-swift-lm MTPContractsV2.swift and are not forwarded to LaunchAgents. They do not touch the attestation, App Attest authorization (TB-011), key custody, or coordinator wire protocol (TB-002). They also do not touch the SSD prefix cache (T-041), including its crypto, TTL, or lookup HMAC names.

Possible indirect effects are limited to the scheduling and hidden-state seeding of speculative decoding. Those could change timing or availability behavior, but the supplied evidence shows only documentation of existing source behavior, and the source implementation is not in this batch. No regression, new attack surface, or invalidated threat assumption is demonstrable from this text. Residual limitation: the actual MTPContractsV2.swift code was not supplied, so I cannot verify that the documented defaults match the implementation. This is a documentation-accuracy question, not a demonstrated security issue.
